summary: Percentage and minimum policies both set minimums and the one giving more instances wins (50% and minimum 2 on 6 nodes gives 3, on 2 nodes gives 2); policies allow overlap, which you avoid by making group percentages add up to 100.
questions: What happens if both policy_instance_percentage and policy_instance_minimum are set?
How do I stop instances being in more than one instance group?
How do I split instances evenly across instance groups?
